debug.description: Turn on debugging output. Warning: may reveal sensitive information like entered pass phrases.

enhanced.description: Ask for timeouts and insurance. Note: this is currently not fully supported.

no_global_grab.description: Grab the keyboard only when the window is focused. Useful for debugging.

ttyname.description: Name of the terminal device (e.g., '/dev/tty1'). Passed by gpg-agent usually.

parent_wid.description: Window ID of the parent window for positioning.
